limitations_and_boundaries: GeneCompass only incorporates data from two species: human and mouse. Inclusion of other species may be offset by species-specific expression patterns.
The model currently uses four types of prior knowledge; other essential information such as enhancers and protein sequences could potentially improve performance.
Only transcriptional data at single-cell level were used; integration of epigenomic, proteomic, and metabolomic data is a future direction.
In silico perturbation predictions require experimental validation, as demonstrated for gonadal differentiation candidate genes.
Homologous genes not available for all genes; species-specific Ensembl IDs were used for non-homologous genes.
The selected source chunks do not report a rescue, reconstitution, reversal, or epistasis experiment; that rung of the causal evidence chain remains untested within this extraction scope.

provenance.text_excerpt: we built an extensive dataset of over 120 million human and mouse single-cell transcriptomes. After data preprocessing, we obtained 101,768,420 single-cell transcriptomes and developed a knowledge-informed cross-species foundation model, named GeneCompass.

claims.statement: GeneCompass is a knowledge-informed cross-species foundation model pre-trained on scCompass-126M, the largest corpus encompassing over 120 million human and mouse single-cell transcriptomes, with 101,768,420 cells used after preprocessing.

datasets.description: 126 million human and mouse single-cell transcriptomes from public databases (GEO, CNCB, EMBL-EBI ArrayExpress, CELLxGENE); after filtering 101,768,420 cells retained.
datasets.name: scCompass-126M

experiments_or_tasks: Constructed scCompass-126M corpus of over 120 million human and mouse single-cell transcriptomes; after preprocessing 101,768,420 cells retained.
Input: top 2048 ranked genes per cell with concatenated absolute expression values and gene IDs, plus species token. Output: 768-dimension gene and cell embeddings.
Integrated four types of prior biological knowledge: promoter sequences, gene co-expression networks, gene family information, and transcription factor-target gene regulatory relationships.
Pre-trained GeneCompass on 101.76 million cells using a 12-layer transformer with 768 hidden size, 12 attention heads, and over 100 million parameters.
Used masked language modeling strategy, masking 15% of gene inputs per cell, with multi-task learning to predict both gene ID (cross-entropy loss) and expression value (MSE loss).

methods.name: GeneCompass pre-training
methods.protocol_description: 12-layer transformer (L=12, H=12, D=768) with GELU activation, dropout 0.02, layer-norm epsilon 1e-12. Pre-trained with batch size 10, learning rate linear decay with 10,000 warm-up steps, max lr 5e-5, AdamW optimizer, for 3 epochs on 4x8 NVIDIA A800 GPUs. Input: top 2048 genes per cell after ranking by expression, concatenated absolute expression value and gene ID, plus species token. Four prior knowledge types (promoter, GRN, gene family, co-expression) encoded into unified embedding space. Masked language modeling: 15% of genes masked; multi-task loss: L = (1-β)L_ID + βL_exp (β hyperparameter).
